title: Itty Bitty Camps — Parent & Child Nature
description: A parent-and-child nature program based out of Discovery Park. Only $30 per session to add a sibling, which makes it workable for families with more than one little one.

title: Rhythmic Gymnastics Camp
description: Multilingual coaches teach ballet, ribbon, hoops, and tumbling alongside free play, games, and crafts. Only one week offered per age group in July.

title: Year-Round Swim Lessons & Open Swim
description: Community pool in Crown Hill offering year-round swim lessons in small classes for ages 2 and up. Monthly membership-based pricing with open swim times for families.

title: Junior Chef Classes in Real Restaurant Kitchens
description: Pop-up cooking school held in working restaurant kitchens across Seattle. Kids learn safe knife skills, recipe reading, and proper techniques from professional chefs in an authentic culinary environment.
